newsitem.title: USA: JPE to acquire Canadian auto trim firm.
newsitem.headline: JPE to acquire Canadian auto trim firm.

text.p: JPE Inc said on Thursday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire for about C$30 million, all of the outstanding shares of Pebra Inc, a Canadian company that supplies plastic injection-molded exterior trim for the automotive industry.
Pebra sales for 1996 are expected to be in excess of C$80 million (US$60 million). It currently operates manufacturing facilities in Kitchener and Peterborough, Ontario, Canada.
The transaction is subject to creditor and government approval and JPE's completion of its due diligence.
If all requirements are met, JPE said it expects the proposed transaction to close by the end of 1996.
JPE said the proposed acquisition will enhance its manufacturing capabilities, provide patented technologies and complement its current automotive trim companies.
JPE acquires and develops companies that manufacture and/or distribute automotive and truck components for the original equipment manufacturers and the aftermarket.
